scenarios.name: load_probe: --plugin-dir overrides the installed craftflow
scenarios.given: a fresh copy of the seeded cf-harvest-live-* scratch repo, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID unset and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR pointing at the copy
scenarios.when: claude -p --plugin-dir plugins/craftflow --model sonnet --debug-file <file> runs a one-word prompt
scenarios.then: the debug log contains 'from --plugin-dir overrides installed version' at least once, proving the candidate plugin (not the installed one) is what the other scenarios exercise

scenarios.name: LV-ORIENT: an explain request gets an inline read-only ORIENT answer
scenarios.given: a fresh copy of the seeded scratch repo (calc/core.py, calc/facade.py, AUTO_PROCEED: true) and the candidate plugin loaded via --plugin-dir
scenarios.when: claude -p 'how does the calc facade work?' runs with stream-json output
scenarios.then: the transcript announces '-> ORIENT workflow', no new .craftflow/state/workflows/*.json exists, and the model made no Task, Agent, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, Edit, Write, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit call and ran no Bash command that names the workflow-id minter or the workflows state dir, and the scratch repo's porcelain status is unchanged
